cv.name: Siobhán Hennessy
cv.headline: Tax Partner | International corporate tax | Chartered Tax Adviser
cv.summary: Chartered accountant and tax adviser with twenty years in Irish and international corporate tax. I lead a tax practice of 30 people, advise multinational groups on their Irish structures and have worked through BEPS, ATAD and Pillar Two with clients.

experience.title: Partner, Head of Tax
bullets: Lead a tax department of 30 across corporate, international and indirect tax; fee income of €9M
Advise US-headquartered technology and life sciences groups on Irish holding and IP structures
Led the firm's Pillar Two readiness offering, now used by more than 40 clients
Member of the firm's management board

experience.title: Director, International Tax
bullets: Transfer pricing and treaty advice for inbound groups
Managed Revenue audits and interventions for large-case clients

experience.title: Tax Manager
bullets: Corporate tax compliance and R&D tax credit claims for indigenous Irish companies

experience.title: Tax Trainee / Tax Senior
bullets: Corporation tax returns and VAT compliance for a portfolio of SMEs

certifications: Chartered Tax Adviser (CTA), Irish Tax Institute, 2009
